hero.eyebrow: A LITTLE MORE HUMAN, A LITTLE MORE HELPFUL
hero.subtitle: Your calm, capable personal assistant for the everyday. Ask a question, run a quick calculation, or just say hello.
hero.privacyNote: Open-ended questions can use your configured Cortex LLMHoster. Conversation history is saved in this browser.

composer.label: Message PyBoT
composer.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
composer.disclaimer: Open-ended messages may be sent to your configured local Cortex model. Its answers can be wrong.

status.title: ASSISTANT STATUS
status.readyBody: Your personal assistant is ready for a question, a calculation, or a quick check-in.
status.footer: Made to make the little things easier.
language.label: Interface language
modal.language.title: Add a language
modal.language.description: Create a language pack for the interface and assistant replies. It will be saved in this browser.
modal.language.help: Only translate what you need; missing keys fall back to English.
modal.language.errorObject: Translations must be a JSON object of text values.
modal.language.errorName: Enter a language name and a valid language code (for example, it or pt-BR).
modal.language.errorDuplicate: A language with that code already exists.
modal.language.errorTooLong: One or more translations are too long.
modal.language.saved: Language added. You can switch to it now.
about.title: Simple, useful, and honest.
about.body: PyBoT runs on a Python server and can use your configured local Cortex model for open-ended questions. Chat history stays in this browser; those prompts are sent to the configured host.
about.fact2: Conversation history stays in this browser
about.fact3: Custom language and command packages are saved locally
response.greeting: Hello! I'm PyBoT. What would you like to work on?
response.help: I can tell you the local time and date, solve quick calculations, and take voice-dictated messages. For open-ended questions, I can use your configured local Cortex model.
response.identity: I'm PyBoT, your personal assistant. Open-ended answers come from Cortex LLMHoster when it is available.
response.joke: Why did the computer get cold? It left its Windows open.
response.mathError: I couldn't safely evaluate that expression. Try a simple calculation such as 248 × 17.
response.unknown: Cortex isn't available right now, so I'm in local assistant mode. I can help with time, date, and calculations. Start a local Cortex model for open-ended questions.
message.copyError: Clipboard access is unavailable in this browser.
toast.storageError: This browser could not save the change.
toast.assistantError: I couldn't reach the PyBoT assistant server. Check that PyBoT is running.
package.title: Build a command package
package.description: Create reusable phrase commands for a language, then install them or export a portable JSON package.
package.commandsHelp: Add phrases PyBoT should recognize and the text it should reply with.
package.triggersPlaceholder:
One phrase per line, e.g.
start evening mode
package.triggersHelp: Add up to 10 phrases. Matching ignores capitalization and punctuation.
package.safeNote: Text replies only—packages never run shell commands or Python code. Use {time} and {date} as reply placeholders.
package.installedEmpty: No command packages yet. Build one above or import a JSON package.
package.errorName: Enter a package name (up to 80 characters).
package.errorLanguage: Choose a valid language for this package.
package.errorCommands: Add at least one command (maximum 12 per package).
package.errorCommandName: Give every command a name (up to 64 characters).
package.errorTriggers: Each command needs 1–10 trigger phrases, each up to 120 characters.
package.errorDuplicateTrigger: A trigger phrase is repeated. Make each phrase unique within the package.
package.errorReply: Add a text reply for every command.
package.errorReplyTooLong: Each reply must be 500 characters or fewer.
package.errorLimit: A package can contain up to 12 commands.
package.errorInvalid: The package could not be created. Check the fields and try again.
package.errorJson: That file is not valid JSON.
package.errorFormat: This is not a supported PyBoT command package.
package.errorFileTooLarge: Package files must be 128 KB or smaller.
package.languageHelp: Choose from 170+ languages and regional variants.
package.languageSearchPlaceholder: Search by language name or code…
